resources.string: Show scheduled departures for this place
Import an offline timetable pack and view scheduled departures without a network connection.
Close and reopen the timetable before selecting another pack.
No timetable pack installed. Import a .ctpack file to use offline schedules.
No scheduled departures in the next service window.
The timetable pack is unavailable. Its data or trust checks could not be completed.
No file picker is available to choose a pack.
Import failed. The previous pack, if any, was kept.
The pack changed, but could not be reopened or cleanup could not finish. Reopen the timetable to check its current state. The previous pack was not restored.
This pack has expired; schedules may be outdated.
This pack is not yet valid; schedules start in the future.
Untrusted user import. SHA-256 checks content integrity, not publisher identity.
Authenticated official pack · key %1$s · sequence %2$d · authorization until %3$s. Verified against configured pack keys; not operator certification.
Pack authorization expired or unavailable. Schedules are unavailable; the pack was not switched to untrusted mode.
Pack unavailable: current data or trust validation failed. No automatic trust downgrade.
Data: %1$s · License: %2$s (%3$s) · Service window up to %4$d hours
cancelled, this departure will not run
scheduled only, no live data for this departure
Offline scheduled preview. Live requests are disabled in this build.
Select a stop before requesting live data.
%1$d departures do not serve this stop

Offline scheduled preview. Starts on a selected platform, not at your location. Station choices include their platforms but no time to reach them. Default search: No walking links, platform changes, accessibility checks or live predictions. The optional mapped action adds a direct link and limited mapped final walks to the selected destination.
Select an origin and a destination explicitly, then plan a departure now.
Choose the intended station or platform below.
Scheduled itinerary found within the selected limits.
No itinerary found in this preview. This does not mean no public transport connection exists.
This installed pack supports departure boards only. Journey planning needs a format 2 timetable pack. Your installed pack was not changed.
Journey data changed, expired or could not be validated. Recheck the timetable and select the endpoints again. No trust downgrade or network fallback.
Search: next 3 hours, at most 3 boardings, same-platform transfers only. No walking to, between or from platforms; no fastest-route or guaranteed-connection claim.
Search is incomplete. Any shown itinerary is only a scheduled feasible option; another connection may exist or arrive earlier.
Work or cooperative time limit reached.
Conflicting published transfer rules could not be resolved.
Linked or in-seat transfers are not supported in this preview.
The requested window extends beyond timetable coverage.
Origin and destination share a selected platform. No vehicle leg is required in this platform-ready query.
Take %1$s towards %2$s Board at %3$s Scheduled departure: %4$s
Change at the same platform: %1$s. Published transfer constraints were checked; this is not a live connection guarantee.
Some times are approximate or their timing precision is not confirmed.
Walking guidance is not available in this preview.
Offline scheduled preview with explicitly routed walking paths. Starts at a selected platform, not your location. Walking estimates do not verify station access or accessibility. No live predictions.
Only supplied mapped walking paths and same-platform scheduled transfers are searched. Unprovided connections may be missing; no city-wide fastest-route or guaranteed-connection claim.
Walk from %1$s to %2$s: about %3$d min (%4$.0f m).
Walking times estimated when this route was planned:\nStart: %1$s\nArrival: %2$s
Mapped road path estimate. Station entrances, platform access, barriers and accessibility are unverified.
A mapped walking path cannot be reused at another departure time. Connections may be missing.
Mapped planning is unavailable. Recheck the timetable and installed maps, or use timetable-only planning.

Optional: select one explicit platform at each end. Tries a direct mapped path and up to 4 shared walking-link queries. If the origin has no ordinary boarding departure in the search window, tries other platforms at the same station until a mapped walk reaches a catchable departure (up to 32 platforms). Returns at most one initial link, not all alternatives. Remaining queries try final walks from reached transit stops to the selected destination. Both use an 800 m straight-line nomination limit; real paths may be longer. No interchange walking; station access remains unverified. Uses one eligible installed map and may copy up to 128 MiB into private cache. No download or active-navigation change; missing paths are not invented.
Mapped walking-link search or query limit reached. Other connections may be missing.
Mapped walking outline — no street basemap
North up · A: Start · B: End. Road-path estimate; station access remains unverified.
North-up mapped walking outline. A marks the start; B marks the end. No street basemap or verified platform access.
Path outline unavailable for this geometry.
Mapped road-path directions, not live navigation. Distances are from the start of this walk. The road-path end does not establish station or platform access.
Turn instructions are unavailable for this path. The outline alone is not turn-by-turn guidance.
Show this walking leg on the street map
Temporary walking-path preview · no live guidance. Station and platform access remain unverified.
Walking map preview unavailable or no longer current. Any existing navigation is unchanged.
Platform choices restored. The previous journey is no longer current. Plan again for updated departure times and walking paths.

Optional: select one explicit platform at each end. Adds at most one mapped initial walking link and limited final walks; no interchange walking; station access remains unverified. Uses an installed map and may copy up to 128 MiB into private cache; no download or active-navigation change.
The planned departure time has passed. Your platform choices are kept — plan again for current departures.
The previous journey cannot be restored. Reload the timetable if needed, select the origin and destination again, then plan a new journey.
